name: C6-2 ViT: 16 patches through one Transformer block
description: Each 4x4 patch becomes one of 16 48-number tokens

params.label: Final patch hiddens (16, 48) — feed to MLP classifier head

data.noteContent:
How a Transformer reads an image at all: stop treating it as a grid and make it a sequence. Edu-Patchify cuts the 16x16 picture into sixteen 4x4 tiles and flattens each tile's 3 x 4 x 4 numbers into one 48-number token. After that nothing is image-specific - positions are added, then LayerNorm, attention and a feed-forward layer run once each, as they would over words. C4-3 adds the two residuals that make that a full block.

Squeeze is not decoration. These Edu nodes read dimension 0 as the sequence, so the batch dimension has to go before attention sees one sequence of sixteen tokens rather than sixteen sequences of one token.

Out comes (16, 48), sixteen patch hiddens. A real ViT prepends a class token and classifies from that row, and ViT-Base stacks twelve full blocks.

Transformer 要讀影像，第一步就是別再把它當網格，改成一段序列。Edu-Patchify 把 16x16 的圖切成十六塊 4x4 的小方塊，再把每塊的 3 x 4 x 4 個數字攤平成一個 48 個數字的 token。之後就沒有任何和影像有關的東西了 - 加上位置，再各跑一次 LayerNorm、注意力和前饋層，跟處理文字時一模一樣。C4-3 補上兩個殘差，才算完整的區塊。

Squeeze 不是裝飾。這些 Edu 節點把第 0 維當成序列，所以要先把 batch 那一維拿掉，注意力看到的才是一段十六個 token 的序列，而不是十六段各只有一個 token 的序列。

輸出是 (16, 48)，十六個 patch 的 hidden。真正的 ViT 會在前面加一個 class token，從那一列做分類，而且 ViT-Base 堆的是十二個完整區塊。

Two numbers fall out of patch_size. The token count is (16 / 4) squared = 16, and a token's width is channels x patch_size squared = 3 x 4 x 4 = 48. Drop patch_size to 2 for 64 tokens of 12, raise it to 8 for 4 of 192. Every width downstream has to follow.

patch_size 一動，兩個數字跟著動。token 數是 (16 / 4) 的平方 = 16，每個 token 的寬度是通道數 x patch_size 平方 = 3 x 4 x 4 = 48。改成 2 會得到 64 個寬 12 的 token，改成 8 則是 4 個寬 192。下游每一處寬度都要跟著改。
